name: A-PIHP
summary: Quite new Pyrrolidine based stimulant of the cathinone class. There is limited information on this drug. The drug is suspected to increase tolerance rapidly. The drug is also reported to lack effects over time as that tolerance builds.
advisory: Avoid: Other stimulants and drugs that raise blood pressure.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: In a classic 2006 study of pyrrolidinyl cathinone derivatives by Meltzer et al. at Organix, the alpha-isobutyl derivative of pyrovalerone, O-2494, was found to have the highest potency in vitro as an inhibitor of the dopamine transporter of the alpha substituted derivatives tested. Compared to α-PVP and α-PHP, α-PiHP displays a higher selectivity for the dopamine transporter.

uses.text: α-Pyrrolidinoisohexanophenone (mainly known as A-PiHP or α-PiHP) is a stimulant drug of the cathinone class that has been sold online as a designer drug. In July 2016 α-PiHP was first identified as a designer drug when it was reported to the EUDA by a forensic laboratory in Slovenia.

summaryZh: α-吡咯烷基苯異己酮是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C16H23NO，屬於卡西酮衍生物，具有去甲腎上腺素-多巴胺再吸收抑制劑作用，2016年在斯洛維尼亞被發現。
summaryZhHans: α-吡咯烷基苯异己酮是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C16H23NO，属于卡西酮衍生物，具有去甲肾上腺素-多巴胺再吸收抑制剂作用，2016年在斯洛文尼亚被发现。

sideEffects.en: Users report that tolerance builds very quickly and that effects fade with repeated use, which encourages redosing. Like other α-pyrrolidinophenones it can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, insomnia, agitation, paranoia and psychosis, and it can lead to dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 使用者表示耐受性上升極快，反覆使用後作用逐漸消失，這會促使人一再追加用藥。和其他α-吡咯烷苯酮一樣，它可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、失眠、躁動、多疑與精神病，也可能導致成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 用户表示耐受性上升极快，反复使用后作用逐渐消失，这会促使人一再追加用药。和其他α-吡咯烷苯酮一样，它可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、失眠、躁动、多疑与精神病，也可能导致成瘾。

fact.en: It was first identified as a designer drug in 2016. Its branched isobutyl side chain matches that of O-2494, which in a 2006 study was the strongest blocker of the dopamine transporter in its series.
fact.zh: 它在2016年首次被確認為設計師藥物。它分岔的異丁基側鏈與O-2494相同，而在2006年的一項研究中，O-2494是該系列中阻斷多巴胺轉運體最強的化合物。
fact.zhHans: 它在2016年首次被确认为设计师药物。它分岔的异丁基侧链与O-2494相同，而在2006年的一项研究中，O-2494是该系列中阻断多巴胺转运体最强的化合物。
